channel.title: AI News — A Guide to Cloud & AI
channel.description: Daily AI news digest — curated headlines, summaries and trends

item.title: Your old iPad or Android tablet can be your new smart home panel - here's how
item.description: Old tablets can be repurposed as smart home control panels, allowing users to manage devices more conveniently. This offers a sustainable way to utilize outdated technology.

item.title: glassbox-mech-interp 4.2.6
item.description: The latest version of glassbox-mech-interp focuses on mechanistic interpretability and compliance with the EU AI Act, enhancing AI model transparency. It includes various frameworks for improved AI understanding.

item.title: sage-ai-cli 1.13.34
item.description: Sage AI CLI version 1.13.34 offers a local-first coding interface using free and open AI models, similar to Claude Code. This tool aims to enhance coding efficiency and accessibility.

item.title: Aegean Shipping: Strategic partnership with Danaos Consultants
item.description: Aegean Shipping is partnering with Danaos Consultants to develop AI-driven digital technology for improved operational efficiency. This collaboration signifies a shift towards digital transformation in the shipping industry.

item.title: Ethereum Exchange Supply Is Back to 2021 Levels: Learn What Happens When Demand Returns
item.description: Ethereum's exchange supply has returned to 2021 levels as it attempts to break through resistance near $2,400, reflecting market uncertainty and potential recovery. This situation could impact investor sentiment and trading strategies.

item.title: 714. The Edge of Space-Time with Dr. Chanda Prescod-Weinstein
item.description: The podcast features Dr. Chanda Prescod-Weinstein discussing theoretical physics and her book on space-time. This conversation aims to bridge complex scientific concepts with broader audiences.

item.title: The Window Is Closing: AI Chatbots Are Poisoning Public Health with Misinformation
item.description: AI chatbots are contributing to a public health misinformation crisis, exacerbating the challenges of accessing accurate health information. This issue raises concerns about the reliability of AI in sensitive areas.

item.title: No country left behind with sovereign AI
item.description: The discussion on digital sovereignty and sovereign AI emphasizes the importance of national control over AI technologies. This topic is increasingly relevant as countries seek to protect their digital interests.

item.title: Duke Extends Manny Diaz
item.description: Duke University has extended the contract of football coach Manny Diaz, signaling confidence in his leadership. This decision could impact the team's future performance and recruitment.

item.title: I don't want a screenshot of your Claude conversation - daverupert.com
item.description: The article critiques the limitations of language models, arguing that they may not be suitable for tasks requiring precise information. This highlights the need for appropriate tool selection in AI applications.

item.title: Using Claude Code: session management and 1M context | Claude
item.description: The article explains how to effectively manage context in Claude Code, detailing methods for session continuation, rewinding, and using subagents for context management. This is significant for developers using Claude Code to optimize their applications.

item.title: Swiss Style Graphic Design Has Shaped Every Screen, Sign, and Brand You See Today
item.description: This article explores the Swiss Style graphic design movement, highlighting its historical significance and influential figures like Müller-Brockmann and Hofmann. Its impact on modern design is evident in various visual media today.

item.title: graph-knowledge-doc-parser added to PyPI
item.description: A new document parser has been added to PyPI, utilizing a large language model (LLM) with graph knowledge capabilities. This tool aims to enhance document processing by integrating advanced AI features.

item.title: burmesegpt added to PyPI
item.description: The 'burmesegpt' package has been introduced to PyPI, providing a Burmese-first runtime compatible with OpenAI's local API workflow. This development aims to support Burmese language processing in AI applications.

item.title: Orange Pi Zero 3W arrives with A733 SoC in 65 × 32 mm design
item.description: The Orange Pi Zero 3W has been launched, featuring a compact design with an Allwinner A733 processor, octa-core CPU, and wireless connectivity. This new single-board computer offers powerful capabilities in a small form factor.

item.title: Show HN: Treat Google Docs as Markdown
item.description: A new tool allows users to treat Google Docs as Markdown, enabling easier editing and formatting. The ExtraSuite application manages differences between Markdown and Google Docs, streamlining the editing process.

item.title: Reed Hastings Leaving Netflix Board After Nearly 30 Years
item.description: Reed Hastings, co-founder of Netflix, will leave the company's board after nearly 30 years, marking the end of an era for the streaming giant. His departure is significant as he played a crucial role in transforming media consumption.

item.title: Reinsurers Least Successful Acquirers in Industry M&A: Analysis
item.description: An analysis reveals that 75% of recent mergers and acquisitions involving reinsurers and multiline insurers have destroyed shareholder value. This report highlights the challenges faced in the insurance industry regarding M&A success.

item.title: Is Coding Still Worth Learning in 2026? – Analysis With AI Available Around
item.description: This analysis discusses the relevance of learning coding in 2026, considering the rise of AI tools that may replace certain coding tasks. It evaluates the skills that remain valuable despite technological advancements.

item.title: Downloaded bad .msi file, did not run it, help needed with Farbar Recovery Scan
item.description: A user seeks help after downloading a potentially malicious .msi file but not executing it. The post highlights concerns about malware and the importance of cybersecurity awareness.

item.title: Bank of England Says it Is Testing AI Risks to Financial Ssystem
item.description: The Bank of England is testing AI risks to the financial system through scenario analysis and simulations, highlighting concerns over AI's impact on financial stability.

item.title: Is America on the Verge of a Nuclear Renaissance?
item.description: The U.S. may be on the brink of a nuclear renaissance as regulatory reforms and advancements in technology could revitalize the nuclear energy sector.

item.title: Denis Staunton: As EU leaders beat a path to Beijing, their tone shifts
item.description: EU leaders are adjusting their rhetoric towards China, with Spain's Prime Minister avoiding overt comparisons of democratic values during his recent visit.

item.title: Welcome to agentic AI. Welcome to per-agent licensing
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a per-agent billing model for its Copilot feature, potentially increasing costs for customers using multiple agents.

item.title: reBot Arm B601-DM – An open-source 6+1 DoF robotic arm for embodied AI and teleoperation applications
item.description: Seeed Studio has launched the reBot Arm B601-DM, an open-source robotic arm designed to facilitate embodied AI learning and teleoperation.

item.title: mcp-tw-judgment added to PyPI
item.description: A new MCP server has been added to PyPI, enabling AI-driven searches of Taiwan's judicial judgments, enhancing legal research capabilities.

item.title: langchain-kerq added to PyPI
item.description: The LangChain integration for Kerq trust scoring and telemetry has been added to PyPI, expanding AI capabilities in trust assessment.

item.title: langchain-kerq 0.1.0
item.description: LangChain version 0.1.0 has been released, featuring integration for Kerq trust scoring and telemetry, facilitating better AI performance tracking.

item.title: Accelerate Clean, Modular, Nuclear Reactor Design with AI Physics
item.description: AI is being leveraged to accelerate the design of clean, modular nuclear reactors, aiming for safety, efficiency, and sustainability.

item.title: Musk’s SpaceX is shaping up as biggest IPO on record
item.description: SpaceX is preparing for a record-breaking IPO, targeting a valuation of $2 trillion while planning to raise $75 billion from public investors.

item.title: Olivia Rodrigo Gets Versailles to Herself in New “Drop Dead” Video
item.description: Olivia Rodrigo has released the music video for her lead single 'Drop Dead' from her upcoming album, 'You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love.' This marks a significant moment in her career as she continues to build on her popularity.

item.title: David McCullagh is a drawler whose sensitivity training needs a tweak, but it works
item.description: David McCullagh's recent radio segment has drawn attention for its unique approach to sensitivity training, which has shown effectiveness despite some initial confusion among listeners.

item.title: Starlink outage hit drone tests, exposing Pentagon's growing reliance on SpaceX
item.description: A recent Starlink outage disrupted US Navy drone tests, underscoring the military's increasing dependence on SpaceX's satellite network for critical operations.

item.title: The OpenAI Pixel Has Landed; Amazon’s Credit Card Ban Triggers An Ad Boycott
item.description: OpenAI has launched its own tracking pixel, while Amazon's credit card ban has led to a boycott from sellers, indicating tensions in the advertising ecosystem.

item.title: Djangocon EU: supply chain attacks on Python projects - Mateusz Bełczowski
item.description: At Djangocon EU, Mateusz Bełczowski discussed the risks of supply chain attacks on Python projects, emphasizing the importance of securing dependencies.

item.title: ami-torchcodec 0.12.0a4
item.description: The release of ami-torchcodec 0.12.0a4 introduces a new video decoder for PyTorch, enhancing its capabilities for machine learning applications.

item.title: Intel Core Series 3 “Wildcat Lake” processor family launched for entry-level laptops and Edge AI systems
item.description: Intel has officially launched its Core Series 3 'Wildcat Lake' processors, designed for entry-level laptops and Edge AI systems, marking a step forward in hybrid AI-ready technology.

item.title: Perplexity brings its Personal Computer AI assistant to Mac
item.description: Perplexity has launched its Personal Computer AI assistant for Mac, enhancing its multi-model orchestration capabilities and expanding its user base.

item.description: Google's Gemini can now utilize user data from Google Photos to personalize image generation, expanding its 'Personal Intelligence' features.

item.title: Show HN: Ask your AI to start a business for you, resolved.sh
item.description: A new platform, resolved.sh, allows users to collaborate with AI to start businesses, offering tools for creating websites and selling digital products.
